description: Generate a structured compliance/governance report from accumulated audit records. Returns all logged compliance checks with statistics. Use for periodic compliance reviews, audit preparation, or governance dashboards. Supports filtering by domain, date range, or compliance status.

compliant_only.description: If true, show only compliant records. If false, show only non-compliant. Omit for all.

domain.description: Filter by domain (e.g. 'regulation'). Omit for all domains.

format.description: Report format: summary (overview + stats), detailed (all records), json (machine-readable)

name: compliance_report
